title: HoloMap: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common HoloMap failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If the map becomes noisy, delete stale markers, rename important waypoints, and separate danger marks from storage or mission marks.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If the map feels cluttered, archive old marks, rename vague points, keep only active routes visible, and mark exits before objectives.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
